req.title: Reject wrong method on /post
req.statement: The system shall respond with HTTP 405 for methods other than POST on /post.

doc.reasoning: The requirement specifies that the /post endpoint should only accept POST requests and return a 405 Method Not Allowed for any other HTTP methods. This ensures that the endpoint is used correctly and prevents misuse. The test suite will include a positive test for a valid POST request, a negative test for an invalid GET request, and a boundary test for an edge case like an unsupported HTTP method.

tests.name: test_post_method_allowed
actions: Send a POST request to the /post endpoint.
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()
response = client.post('/post', data={'key': 'value'})
assert response.status_code == 200
assert 'application/json' in response.content_type

tests.name: test_get_method_not_allowed
actions: Send a GET request to the /post endpoint.
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()
response = client.get('/post')
assert response.status_code == 405
assert 'Method Not Allowed' in response.status

tests.name: test_put_method_not_allowed
actions: Send a PUT request to the /post endpoint.
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()
response = client.put('/post')
assert response.status_code == 405
assert 'Method Not Allowed' in response.status
